input.quote: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale: Article IV (p0049) is the only renewal provision in the Agreement. It lets Licensor unilaterally extend the 36-month Initial Period by a further seven years at its sole option, with no Licensee consent, no non-renewal notice window and no cap on renewal length. That is a multi-year renewal imposed on us and sits in walk-away territory, well below the fallback (non-renewal window of no more than 60 days). It also contradicts the same Article's sentences II and III, which contemplate extension only "by mutual written of the parties" / "by mutual agreement in writing". We therefore delete the unilateral option and make renewal mutual-written-agreement only, which satisfies the preferred position; the remaining preferred elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder) and the price-uplift cap are conditional on automatic renewal and renewal price increases, neither of which exists once the Licensor option is removed (the user-fee schedule in Article V contains no renewal uplift mechanic).

ops.oldText: The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
ops.newText: The Agreement may be renewed only by mutual written agreement of the parties.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a seven-year extension exercisable at Licensor's sole option, which is an automatic multi-year renewal in substance and inconsistent with the mutual-extension language in the same Article. We have made renewal mutual written agreement only, consistent with our preferred renewal position.
proposal.summary: Renewal only by mutual written agreement; remove Licensor's unilateral 7-year extension option.
